summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Smith & Nephew plc, a foreign private issuer, reporting share purchases by directors and PDMRs under the company's Employee Stock Purchase Plan through a dividend reinvestment plan. The filing discloses standard post-dividend ADR purchases at $29.8328 per ADS by five individuals on June 3, 2026. There are no special-situation elements — no acquisition, disposition, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, or similar event. The sole purpose is periodic notification of insider transactions under UK MAR. Accordingly, this filing is classified as None.
